# library-brain

A static library of books with a prebuilt semantic index. Everything below is a plain file next to this one.

- brain/data/meta.json      books (title, slug, passage range), model, dimensions, prompts
- brain/data/passages.json  [[book_index, chapter_file, chapter_title, section, text], ...]
- brain/data/vec768.i8      int8 vectors, n x 768 (EmbeddingGemma, normalised; divide by meta.scale_full)
- brain/data/vec.i8         int8 vectors, n x 256 (Matryoshka cut, used for the map; divide by meta.scale)
- brain/data/knn.u32        n x 4 nearest passages in meaning
- <slug>/<chapter_file>/    the chapter as a web page

To search by meaning, embed your query with the same model and the query prompt in meta.json, then take the dot product
with vec768. Without an embedding model, match words in passages.json.
